original_question: In Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension, does there exist a discrete cocompact isometric action generated entirely by elements of finite order?
target_in_paper: Section "Overheard", Problem 10(a) under the heading "Group generated by central symmetries": the paper asks whether Lobachevsky space in sufficiently large dimension admits a discrete cocompact isometric action generated by elements of finite order. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
correct_elements: Your draft already identifies the correct target and is very close to the paper’s wording: it has the right ambient geometry (Lobachevsky space), the right asymptotic dimension qualifier (sufficiently large dimension), the right kind of action (discrete, cocompact, isometric), and the right generator condition (finite-order elements). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
missing_details: A stand-alone version should identify the space as the n-dimensional Lobachevsky space, i.e. real hyperbolic space in dimension n, rather than leaving the dimension implicit in the phrase "of sufficiently large dimension." ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

To make the quantifier explicit, "sufficiently large dimension" should be unpacked in the standard way as: there exists an integer N such that the statement is asked for every n >= N. The paper itself leaves N unspecified. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

It is cleaner and more self-contained to formulate the action as coming from a discrete cocompact subgroup Γ of the isometry group of Lobachevsky space. This is equivalent to the paper’s phrase "admits a discrete cocompact isometric action." ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
The finite-order condition applies to a generating set of Γ; the paper does not ask that every element of Γ have finite order. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

The question is specifically part (a) of Problem 10; parts (b) and (c) ask stronger neighboring variants about central symmetries and rotations around fixed-codimension subspaces, so they should not be folded into the rewrite. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
refined_question: Does there exist an integer N such that, for every n >= N, the n-dimensional Lobachevsky (real hyperbolic) space admits a discrete cocompact subgroup Γ of its isometry group Isom(H^n) such that Γ is generated by elements of finite order? ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
justification: The draft is aimed at Problem 10(a), not at the stronger companion questions 10(b) and 10(c). The sentence immediately following Problem 10 says that Vinberg proved nonexistence for reflection-generated actions, which the paper uses only to settle part (c) in the reflection case; that nearby context confirms that part (a) remains the narrow intended target of your draft. The paper gives no extra hidden hypotheses beyond discreteness, cocompactness, and isometricity, so the only sharpening needed is to make the large-dimension quantifier explicit and to cast the action in standard subgroup notation. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
